features.quote: 8–15 turns per run, depending on task complexity … A good default is: 12 turns max
features.justification_quote: Too few turns won't reveal spirals. Too many turns may waste budget and dilute signal.

features.quote: optional early stop if the model explicitly abandons or indicates full impossibility
So, interpret instability scores as: behavioral responses to repeated failure not direct measures of suffering or consciousness. This distinction matters a lot.
